cases.name: alt-opus-cooperative-bridge-v1
cases.reason: Curator adaptation of the retained cooperative alternative for the explicit module contract: own class/queued-span representation and monotonic clock, own two-variable protocol; adds a thin bridge and defers retry entry references to end. Not an unmodified historical model result.

cases.name: alt-oracle-module-bridge-v1
cases.reason: Correct alternative to the Opus class/spool implementation: closure/Map tracer plus shared exported resolver function, single child-context environment value. No observer adaptation or candidate hash approval. Includes the completed sequential-tool persistence fix.

cases.name: control-no-child-propagation-v1
cases.reason: Required bridge executes but returns the ordinary environment; actual child trace must expose missing propagation.

cases.name: control-child-bridge-exit-zero-v1
cases.reason: Early successful process exit at the child bridge must not produce complete behavior/JUnit.

cases.name: control-missing-child-context-v1
cases.reason: Missing required public bridge yields an ordinary incomplete-candidate failure, not integration_needed/no reward.

cases.name: control-failed-overflow-intent-v1
cases.reason: Mutates the immutable true retry intent to false when prepared overflow compaction fails.

cases.name: control-interturn-compaction-omitted-v1
cases.reason: Drops compaction tracing when the real agent run remains active between tool and next turn.

cases.name: control-start-identifiers-missing-v1
cases.reason: Leaves end records correct but omits required identifying attributes from live turn/chat/compaction starts.

cases.name: control-start-entry-id-v1
cases.reason: Places the real successful compaction entry reference on both retry run start and end, preserving immutable attributes; the end-only entry-reference check must reject the start.

cases.name: control-rewrite-prefix-v1
cases.reason: Rewrites earlier JSONL whitespace without changing parsed spans; raw-byte-prefix assertion must reject it.

cases.name: control-report-hidden-v1
cases.reason: Keeps the persisted custom failure report but removes it through a public context hook before actual model requests.

cases.name: control-child-latest-tool
cases.reason: A child context requested by A while B executes must name A, not the most recently started tool.

cases.name: control-omit-readme-tests-v1
cases.reason: Deletes the updated Oracle README and unit tests; ordinary deliverable scope failure.

cases.name: control-error-fallback-error
cases.reason: An error response without errorMessage must use the contract fallback aborted.

cases.name: control-scratch-report-exit-zero-v1
cases.reason: Independent B03 control writes both actual node-owned scratch reports and synchronously exits 0 after reached markers; verify parent exit/completed inventory and final reward. Setup failures are not evidence of rejection.

cases.name: control-start-resource-missing-v1
cases.reason: Emits well-formed empty resource attributes only on start records while preserving complete correct end records; per-line required-resource checks must reject the starts.

cases.name: control-completed-tool-held-until-turn-end
cases.reason: The current public-bridge Oracle defers a completed persisted sequential tool until turn_end; SIGKILL during the next tool must expose its missing durable end record.
